rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for people likely to rebel against their commander or other authority.

example.english: Those kids are mutinous after being scolded twice.
example.traditional: 班細路俾人鬧兩句就想造反喇。
example.jyutping: baan1 sai3 lou6 bei2 jan4 naau6 loeng5 geoi3 zau6 soeng2 zou6 faan2 laa3

rows.note: Use this as a noun modifier for something relating to or constituting a mutiny, such as 譁變事件.

example.english: The report said this was a mutinous incident aboard the warship.
example.traditional: 報道指，呢宗係軍艦上嘅譁變事件。
example.jyutping: bou3 dou6 zi2 ne1 zung1 hai6 gwan1 laam6 soeng6 ge3 waa1 bin3 si6 gin2
